name: Cutout Village
description:
About This Game

Cutout Village is a cozy, city-builder and crafting game with an atmospheric narrative about village abandonment. Whether you play in story mode or sandbox, you will have options to customize your medieval-inspired village using building and decoration sheets.

✂️ Cutting, folding and gluing

The mechanics are simple and unique: cut, fold and glue the sheets you collect to unlock new levels with services, and increase population capacity.

This will remind you of old hobbies such as paper crafts, and cutout books that became extremely popular in the 1960s.
Each level will require some tasks that need to be managed with the calm that comes with village life.

🍃 The atmospheric narrative we have all dreamed of

Who hasn't dreamed of bringing back to life a village with friends? In Cutout Village, you will join our main characters through a single-player story that begins with inheriting an old family house in a village where they used to spend their childhood, but is now abandoned.
Experience a narrative revealed through the characters and the city’s needs, while enjoying a small and relaxing indie game inspired by watercolors and crafting books.

🐝 Key features

  • Over 50 cutout buildings and street furniture.

  • PDF sheet gallery for making real-life crafts.

  • Story-mode with an immersive narrative.

  • Sandbox to design and expand your village without limits.

  • Diverse fruit trees to collect.

  • A unique and relaxing mechanic perfect for chilling.
short_desc: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!
